description: Unsigned transaction settling a cover with the feed's first round at or after its reopen (found by walking back from the latest round), with what it pays the buyer. Anyone may send it; the payout always goes to the buyer. When that first print came more than two hours after the reopen, or more than 50% from the reference, or never came in seven days, the transaction voids the cover instead (the premium the pool kept goes back).

id.description: The cover's number (position lists a wallet's covers)

wallet.description: The address that will send it (any address; the payout goes to the cover's buyer)
